<robot name="drawer_cabinet_0">
  <link name="world"/>

  <!-- -------------------- Cabinet body -------------------- -->
  <link name="cabinet_body">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.39" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="40.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="2.20" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="7.10" iyz="0" izz="8.40"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.39" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.43 0.50 0.78"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_body">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.37 0.22 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.39" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.43 0.50 0.78"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- -------------------- Back panel (for better collision) -------------------- -->
  <link name="cabinet_back">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.25 -0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="3.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.10" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.02" iyz="0" izz="0.10"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.24 0.39" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.43 0.02 0.78"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_back">
        <color rgba="0.50 0.34 0.20 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.24 0.39" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.43 0.02 0.78"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- -------------------- Drawer 1 (bottom) -------------------- -->
  <link name="drawer_1">
    <!-- Drawer local geometry: width 0.39, depth 0.42, height 0.246 -->
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="12.0"/>
      <!-- Approximate inertia for a box about its center -->
      <inertia ixx="0.19" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.47" iyz="0" izz="0.45"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.39 0.42 0.246"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_front">
        <color rgba="0.45 0.28 0.16 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.39 0.42 0.246"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- -------------------- Drawer 2 (middle) -------------------- -->
  <link name="drawer_2">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="12.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.19" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.47" iyz="0" izz="0.45"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.39 0.42 0.246"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_front"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.39 0.42 0.246"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- -------------------- Drawer 3 (top) -------------------- -->
  <link name="drawer_3">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="12.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.19" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.47" iyz="0" izz="0.45"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.39 0.42 0.246"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_front"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.39 0.42 0.246"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- -------------------- Joints -------------------- -->
  <!-- Cabinet body to back panel (fixed) -->
  <joint name="joint_body_to_back" type="fixed">
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="cabinet_back"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Drawer slide: axis along +Y (toward front is -Y per statement; so use axis -Y for positive joint travel) -->
  <!-- Base placement: drawer frames at their seated position centered in cabinet interior. -->
  <!-- Drawer dimensions: cabinet width 0.43; clearance ~0.02 each side => drawer width 0.39. -->
  <!-- Drawer depth 0.42; cabinet interior depth from front face -0.25 to back panel near +0.24 => center approx at Y = -0.04 when seated. -->
  <!-- Seated center Y = -0.04, slide along -Y up to +0.04 in magnitude (max travel 0.08). -->
  <!-- Drawer heights: 3 stacked in usable height: (0.78 - 0.06 top/bottom margins)/3 = 0.22? We'll use 0.246 with margins for a reasonable fit. -->
  <!-- Use y/x center at 0 and Z centers at: 0.165, 0.405, 0.645 (each 0.246/2 spacing). -->

  <joint name="joint_drawer_1_slide" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="drawer_1"/>
    <!-- origin is cabinet frame; set drawer center at Z=0.156? Use 0.165 -->
    <origin xyz="0 -0.04 0.165" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
    <limit lower="0" upper="0.08" effort="50" velocity="1.5"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_drawer_2_slide" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="drawer_2"/>
    <origin xyz="0 -0.04 0.405" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
    <limit lower="0" upper="0.08" effort="50" velocity="1.5"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_drawer_3_slide" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="drawer_3"/>
    <origin xyz="0 -0.04 0.645" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
    <limit lower="0" upper="0.08" effort="50" velocity="1.5"/>
  </joint>
</robot>
